# feat(hfp-014): evidence points at a segment and character offsets

## Task

The domain `Evidence` type has only `speakerId`, `text` and optional times. The worker finds where a quote came from afterwards, by word-overlap matching. ADR 0004 stores every quote as an excerpt: segment + `start_offset` / `end_offset`. ADR 0003 says every provider's evidence must point at real segments, so the grounding evals can check it.

Add `segmentId` and offsets to `Evidence`, and have the worker return them. Keep word-overlap matching only as the fallback that finds them when the model doesn't.

## Parent Story

Data model (ADR 0004), AnalysisProvider (ADR 0003).

## Blocked by

- #34 HFP-011 (segments get stable IDs once they're stored)
- #35 HFP-012 (the provider's output type is where evidence is defined)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Evidence` has `segmentId`, `startOffset` and `endOffset` (offsets within the segment text, as in ADR 0004). `text` stays a cached copy that is checked against the offsets.
- [ ] The worker returns these for every evidence item. Evidence it can't place is dropped or flagged, never stored without a segment.
- [ ] The mock data and the deterministic fallback produce valid segment IDs and offsets.
- [ ] Evidence UI (`JobCardEvidencePanel`, the `ResearchWorkbench` highlight) uses the offsets instead of searching the text.
- [ ] Specs: offsets slice the segment text back to exactly `text`; a quote the model invented (not in any segment) is rejected.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-agent`
